candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes a tumor with microscopic features (uniform epithelioid and spindle cells, variable eosinophilic or clear cytoplasm, round to oval vesicular nuclei, up to 10 mitoses per 10 HPF) and immunohistochemical profile (diffuse strong S100 and SOX10 positivity, negative HMB45, Melan A, CD117, DOG1, cytokeratin, CD34, SMA, desmin, chromogranin, CD56, patchy synaptophysin) that are highly characteristic of clear cell sarcoma. The location in the small intestine is also explicitly stated in the record.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: The candidate specifies the anatomical location, which is consistent with the clinical record.
